definitions.explanation: From English "core." As a noun it means the central or most important part of something. As a na-adjective it describes a small but deeply committed group or a niche, hardcore taste, as in コアなファン (devoted fans).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コアな⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This show has many devoted fans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コア⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: We put our energy into the part that forms the core of the business.

examples.japanese: コアな⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧{好|ず}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{聴|き}いて→聴く：30010_kiku⟧ほしい⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an album I especially want hardcore music lovers to listen to.

notes:
Loanword from English "core." Works both as a noun for the central part and as a na-adjective for a niche, devoted, or hardcore character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コアな⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: devoted, hardcore fans
- コア⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧: core demographic
- コア⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: core technology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧: nucleus, core — the native word for a central part, more abstract
- ⟦{中核|ちゅうかく}→中核：11369_chuukaku⟧: nucleus, central pillar — formal term for the most important part of an organization
